opener.greeting: 🌅 You're the Opener today! Here's what you need to take care of:

tasks.text: Turn on all monitors and PC stations
Log into GGLeap and verify all stations are active
Unlock and open the arena door
Ensure the Next Student worker is on Site and clocked in before leaving the Arena

tasks: Report any System Issues to Jay (Mage)

tasks.text: DO NOT LEAVE THE ARENA UNATTENDED AT ALL TIMES

mid.greeting: ☀️ You're the Mid-Shift worker today! Here's what you need to take care of:

tasks.text: Check in with current staff on duty
Monitor the arena and assist students
Report any equipment issues to the director
Report any System Issues to Jay (Mage)
DO NOT LEAVE THE ARENA UNATTENDED AT ALL TIMES

closer.greeting: 🌙 You're the Closer Today! Here's what you need to take care of:

tasks.text: DO NOT LEAVE THE ARENA UNATTENDED AT ALL TIMES
Check in with the current staff on duty
Monitor the arena and assist students
Report any Damage or Missing Equipment to the Director
Report any System Issues to Mage
Ensure all non-varsity students have left the arena
Log all students out of GGLeap
Close and lock the arena door
Report any System Issues to Jay (Mage)
